hook.rumour: At the Buoyant Armiger canton of Molag Mar, pilgrims bound for Mount Assarnibibi report that renegade inquisitors and Tel Aruhn slavers have blockaded the sea-coving toward Holamayan while corprus remedies vanish on the road to Tel Fyr.
hook.notice: MOLAG MAR PILGRIM GARRISON — Escorts and investigators sought to secure the coastal shrines between Molag Mar, Tel Fyr, and the eastern headlands.
hook.context: Azura's Coast is a labyrinth of basalt headlands where Buoyant Armigers, Dissident Priests at Holamayan, Divayth Fyr's corprusarium, and Telvanni lords watch each other across the fog.

quests.title: Alms and Armigers at Molag Mar

stages.objective: Speak with the Buoyant Armiger captain at Molag Mar about the missing medical skiffs
Check the pilgrim way-cairn atop Mount Assarnibibi for signs of the ambushed courier
Deliver the recovered medicine tally to Divayth Fyr's tower at Tel Fyr

objectives.text: Speak with the Buoyant Armiger captain at Molag Mar about the missing medical skiffs
Check the pilgrim way-cairn atop Mount Assarnibibi for signs of the ambushed courier
Deliver the recovered medicine tally to Divayth Fyr's tower at Tel Fyr

consequence_detail.summary: Divayth Fyr's stewards confirm the missing alchemical crates were diverted by rogue factors operating out of Tel Aruhn and Telasero.

stages.objective: Question the dock-masters at Tel Aruhn regarding the seized Holamayan skiff
Inspect the lava-plain relay post at Tel Uvirith
Clear the smuggler-mercenaries inside the stronghold of Telasero and recover the Twilight Compass

objectives.text: Question the dock-masters at Tel Aruhn regarding the seized Holamayan skiff
Inspect the lava-plain relay post at Tel Uvirith
Clear the smuggler-mercenaries inside the stronghold of Telasero and recover the Twilight Compass

consequence_detail.summary: The Twilight Compass is recovered from Telasero, allowing safe navigation to the hidden monastery of Holamayan at dusk.

stages.objective: Deliver the Twilight Compass to Master Gilvas Barelo at Holamayan Monastery
Drive off the rogue inquisitor band encamped in the ruins of Indoranyon
Retrieve the stolen Star-Lamp of Azura from the observatory vaults of Galom Daeus

objectives.text: Deliver the Twilight Compass to Master Gilvas Barelo at Holamayan Monastery
Drive off the rogue inquisitor band encamped in the ruins of Indoranyon
Retrieve the stolen Star-Lamp of Azura from the observatory vaults of Galom Daeus

consequence_detail.summary: The Star-Lamp of Azura is reclaimed from Galom Daeus and the sea-channel to Holamayan is secured.

stages.objective: Relight the Star-Lamp above the sea-gate of Holamayan Monastery
Confirm the safe arrival of the alchemical supply skiff at Tel Fyr
Report the coastal truce to the Buoyant Armiger Commander at Molag Mar

objectives.text: Relight the Star-Lamp above the sea-gate of Holamayan Monastery
Confirm the safe arrival of the alchemical supply skiff at Tel Fyr
Report the coastal truce to the Buoyant Armiger Commander at Molag Mar

consequence_detail.summary: The Star-Lamp burns above Holamayan, medical skiffs reach Tel Fyr unhindered, and Molag Mar's Armigers honor the coastal truce.
